fib: ______ are a peculiar type of agents whose rights, duties and obligations are often spelt out in an agreement, mostly Power of Attorney.
Estate agents are a peculiar type of agents whose rights, duties and obligations are often spelt out in an agreement, mostly Power of Attorney.
______ is an essential part of commercial law because companies can only conduct business through agents.
The law of agency is an essential part of commercial law because companies can only conduct business through agents.
______ is an essential ingredient to determine the existence or otherwise of agency.
Knowledge of insanity is an essential ingredient to determine the existence or otherwise of agency.
______ is one of confidentiality of principal and the agent, and the agent is generally expected to perform his duties as an agent, personally.
Agency relationship is one of confidentiality of principal and the agent, and the agent is generally expected to perform his duties as an agent, personally.
______ is an agent having in the course of his business, as such agent, authority to sell or to consign goods for the purpose of sale, or to buy goods or to raise money on the security of goods.

A mercantile agent is an agent having in the course of his business, as such agent, authority to sell or to consign goods for the purpose of sale, or to buy goods or to raise money on the security of goods.
